mods.abstract: Glass bottle with torn paper label that reads "Oil Juniper Berry" and a glass stopper. Bottle owned by August C. Camoriani (1906-1973), a pharmacist who was born and died in San Francisco. He was the owner of Rossi Drug Co. San Francisco, CA and "Mayor of North Beach" the "Little Italy" neighborhood. He served the Italian immigrant community of San Francisco for more than 40 years.
mods.note: Photographed by Claude Moore Health Sciences Library, Historical Collections and Services staff.
